name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Kneel on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and have a partner hold your ankles firmly down.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly so your torso and thighs form a single straight line from knees to head.
Lower your body forward toward the floor as slowly as possible by resisting gravity with your hamstrings while keeping your hips straight.
Reach your hands toward the floor and bend your elbows to cushion the landing.
Push gently with your hands and draw yourself upright with your hamstrings.
tips: Keep your hips extended flat rather than hinging at the waist as you lower forward.
Emphasize a slow, controlled descent even if you need a light hand push to return to the top.
